title: Causality and the Equivalence Principle for Higher Energy Scattering
summary: Recently, it was proposed that the leading high-energy behavior of scattering amplitudes is universal, independent of charge, thereby extending the equivalence principle beyond the graviton pole. In this Letter, we derive a sharper causality constraint on such behavior by studying the Regge limit of colored scattering. Parameterizing a trajectory by $s^{α(t)}$ with $α(0)=2-δ$, we analyze the Shapiro/Wigner--Smith time-delays in the irreducible scattering channels.
